verdict: Leads surged this week, but none are converting inside the pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 19 leads at an average cost of $160.63 per lead, with all 19 coming from Meta at $41.79 per lead — a strong and efficient result from that channel. The most recent 7-day window saw a 250% jump in leads week-over-week, which drove cost per lead down 69% compared to the prior 7 days. The challenge right now is not ad volume: your pipeline shows 81 opportunities created but none advancing to appointments or won cases, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up with. We are working directly on the intake process to ensure leads that arrive are being contacted and moved forward, and we are watching Meta closely for early signs of creative fatigue after the spike.
